genre_assumption: general mutable-standing account inspired by historical status/tense/privation; Fortune and royal status remain unbound
architectural_prior: IDEA000554 is an existing RAW unreviewed d=HAS / qo=NOT property lifting architecture. This core reuses that architecture as an assumption with aiin=standing; it is neither a new architecture nor an inherited moisture/heat fact. Historical source permits the distinction, but does not identify any carrier.

or.sense: that bearer T of the current block

ol.sense: another bearer A, distinct from T of the current block

qo.sense: NOT(predicate); explicit privation when predicate is HOLD(standing)

t.sense: FUTURE(predicate); nominal argument receives HOLD lifting

ch.sense: definite reference; licensed only with ol in this core

sain.sense: as for; consumes the immediately following NP as topic

opchdy.sense: now; whole form, no proposed internal parse

dair.sense: earlier; whole form, scopes the clause

oteey.sense: now; separately paid synonym of opchdy, no spelling argument

odain.sense: wait; whole form, intransitive, not an alias of daiin

chedy.sense: rise; whole form, intransitive; no cause or value judgment

rules.rule: Read exact ZL groups in native order within each spatial block. Physical line end is not itself a sentence boundary. Authored clause boundaries are separately listed.
or always denotes block-local deictic T; ol always denotes block-local A with A != T. The block deictic anchor is an assumption, not image ownership. No identity is asserted across blocks.
NP+aiin compounding licensed only for oraiin and olaiin: standing OF the named bearer. Such possessive NPs do not switch the grammatical subject.
d lifts aiin to HOLD(standing). A bare aiin used predicatively also receives zero HOLD lifting; this is a separately paid nominal-predication construction, not a second sense.
qo negates its following predicate; t places its predicate strictly after the clause NOW anchor, and sho strictly before it. No past/future predicate entails its present truth value.

All exact ordered part licenses are finite and listed; no substring receives a sense inside an unlicensed form. No dropping e, adding i, or interpreting raw uncertainty/entities as a favorable spelling.

sain NP sets a topic without predicating it. A following independent NP may be the subject. Thus sain or / or aiin is TOPIC(T), SUBJECT(T), HOLD(standing), rather than assigning the two or groups different meanings.
sheo NP sets an aboutness phrase without changing subject. ch+ol is definite A, and as standalone nominative NP switches the subject to A.

An explicit nominative NP consumes the following predicate sequence until a further nominative NP. An omitted subject inherits the nearest earlier explicit nominative within the block; where none exists, its value is UNKNOWN_SUBJECT. No block-to-block inheritance.

Default unmarked clause time is block NOW. dair sets earlier time for its authored clause; opchdy and oteey explicitly set NOW. These adverbs scope the whole declared clause irrespective of surface edge. No token asserts loss merely from earlier possession.

Adjacent complete predicates with inherited subject may form paratactic clauses. Only an provides a lexical AND; punctuation and English subject repetition realize the paid clause/ellipsis grammar and add no causal, adversative or temporal relationship.

assumptions: Status-narrative genre and standing noun are unconfirmed.
Exact candidate segmentation and finite licenses are invented beyond structural baseline.
Block-local deictic anchors T/A are not confirmed picture ownership or source persons.
Authored clause boundaries do not follow from physical lines.
Zero nominal HOLD, ellipsis, past-adverb scope and topic doubling are paid grammar assumptions.
Historical Carmina16 alter requires actor distinction; it does not prove target or/ol identities.
Past holding does not imply present lack; future lack does not imply current lack.
Primary spelling fixed; IT/RF alternatives are preserved but do not receive favorable substitutions.
All outside .1/.24 and every unknown remain untranslated.
No Latin/phonetic assumption, source identity, clockwise order, independent confirmation or reserve eligibility.
strongest_rival: Same constructions with aiin=physiological capacity/moisture and chedy=increase; actor NPs can be substance/bearer references. Many consequences are observationally identical. General status/record wording and lexical renamings remain equivalent.
